  - (fetched by me, text pasted by user; Tokyo Otaku Mode's Otapedia, sections Final Fantasy XII Plot, Gameplay, Characters, Development)
  - Final Fantasy XII Plot: a short summary (Ivalice, Dalmasca annexed by Archadia, Ashe's resistance joined by Vaan, the antagonist Vayne and the battle aboard the Bahamut)
    - agrees with the entry's description (Archadia and Rozarria at war, Vaan meets princess Ashe of Dalmasca)
    - the ending is a spoiler and is not in the description
  - Release: PlayStation 2 in 2006, later re-released as Final Fantasy XII International Zodiac Job System on PlayStation 4 and Steam; consistent with the entry (2006-03-16)
  - Development: the active dimension battle system replaced random encounters, and Uematsu contributed only the ending song; developer content, outside our scope; no new fact
